title: NetPost Beacon & Decision Index for Private Onboarding
creator: Sofia Martinez
notes: Goal: Reduce manual triage time for Private/VPC/on-prem deployment requests by providing a lightweight, customer-run network 'beacon' and an internal Decision Index that maps telemetry to prioritized onboarding lanes.

Problem: Current intake requires multiple manual probes, custom engineering support, and long email threads to understand firewall rules, egress gaps, and intermittent proxy behavior for air-gapped or restricted networks.

Approach: Deliver a self-serve Beacon CLI (customer-run container) that collects non-sensitive connectivity posture signals (outbound IPs/ports, DNS reachability, TLS handshake latencies to known endpoints) and posts a signed report to a transient, customer-controlled S3 bucket or to a pre-approved collector endpoint. Feed those signals into a Decision Index that outputs a recommended triage lane (Fasttrack, Standard, Manual Concierge) and a numeric risk score with remediation suggestions.

Constraints: Must avoid collecting customer payload or PII. Beacon should run offline and emit only metadata. Security review and legal signoff required prior to experimental pilot with customers. Beacon must be optional for customers who use our existing intake form.

Success metrics: 50% reduction in engineering validation time for private onboarding requests; 30% fewer follow-up network calls during first 30 days of rollout; measurable increase in on-time completions for high-priority customers.

UX: Add a short 'Beacon upload' step in the intake form with an expiring upload token and a one-click run command the customer can paste into their bastion/ops host. Console will display Decision Index output and next recommended steps.

Privacy: Telemetry schema drafted to use hashed IP prefixes and coarse port buckets; raw artifacts only visible to the customer and to an authorized Redwood Ops reviewer when explicit consent is granted.
Risks: Customers may be uncomfortable running a container; some legal teams will request additional attestations. Need fallbacks (manual probe scripts and guided calls).
acceptance_criteria: Beacon prototype published to GitHub with reproducible container image and README
Decision Index algorithm documented and reproducible with a test harness (sample reports -> lane mapping)
Intake UI wireframe completed and validated with 3 SEs and 2 pilot customers
Security review checklist signed and SRE playbook for revocation of upload tokens completed
Pilot with two enterprise customers scheduled and smoke tests passing
